# Permit Examples
[bold]Engineering Goggles[/bold] - [bold]From Engineering:[/bold] If you got the goggles from Engineering, you only need the [color=#ff733c]Chief Engineer[/color]'s stamp. - [bold]Purchased from ITG:[/bold] If you bought them from ITG, you need both the [color=#963dca]Salvage Lead[/color]'s stamp and the [color=#ff733c]Chief Engineer[/color]'s stamp.
[bold]Mk 58[/bold] - [bold]From Security:[/bold] If you got the Mk 58 from Security, you only need the [color=#ff6666]Warden[/color]'s stamp. - [bold]Purchased from ITG:[/bold] If you bought it from ITG, you need both the [color=#963dca]Salvage Lead[/color]'s stamp and the [color=#ff6666]Warden[/color]'s stamp.
[bold]Medical Jaws of Life[/bold] - [bold]No Origin (e.g., found in maintenance):[/bold] Since it has no departmental origin and is approved for Medical and Security, you only need a stamp from any one Relevant Leader: the [color=#57b8f0]Chief Medical Officer[/color], [color=#ff6666]Warden[/color], or [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color].
[bold]Green Scrapper Beret[/bold] - As an item not approved for any NT-CC department, you only need the [color=#963dca]Salvage Lead[/color]'s stamp.
[bold]Cat Ears[/bold] - As a Tier 1 Rival Corporation item, you only need the [color=#ff6666]Warden[/color]'s stamp.
[bold]CODE-4 "Triage"[/bold] - As a Tier 4 Affiliated Corporation weapon, you need stamps from [color=#880606]MedTak[/color], the [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], and the [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color].
[bold]Blood-Red Hardsuit[/bold] [color=#ff4242]This entry is restricted to crew with Secure Knowledge.[/color] - As Tier 4 Rival Corporation combat gear, you need stamps from the [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], the [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color], and [color=#86d420]Central Command[/color].
